main.description: Echo main window — minimal-viable permissions. No shell, fs, sql, opener, dialog, process or network permission: the WebView communicates only via explicit Tauri commands/events, cover:// for cover art, and core window introspection getters. `core:window:allow-start-dragging` is one exception: macOS runs this window with `titleBarStyle: Overlay` + `hiddenTitle`, so no native titlebar drags it and the top inset strip must ask the window to drag itself. `core:window:allow-minimize` / `allow-toggle-maximize` / `allow-close` are the Windows counterpart (issue #76): the window runs with `decorations: false` there, so the frontend-drawn caption buttons ask the window to minimize / toggle-maximize / close — `close` being the same CloseRequested → CloseBehavior path the native caption took.
